definitions.explanation: The part of a total (money, profits, food) that a particular person is entitled to take. Often used when money is divided between partners, family members or a company and its workers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{分|ぶん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いくら？
⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{分|ぶん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{揉|も}めた→揉める：07385_momeru⟧。
examples.english: We quarrelled over our shares of the profit.

examples.japanese: {仲介業者|ちゅうかいぎょうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{分|ぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{大|おお}きすぎて、{作|つく}り{手|て}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}らない→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: The middlemen take too big a cut, so very little money is left for the makers.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {取|と}り{分|ぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧ / ⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧: one's share shrinks / grows
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{分|ぶん}: one's own share
- {取|と}り{分|ぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to decide the split

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{分|わ}け{前|まえ}→分け前：25677_wakemae⟧: share, cut; a portion handed out, often of spoils or winnings
- ⟦{配分|はいぶん}→配分：14495_haibun⟧: allocation; the act of dividing, formal

WATCH OUT:
⟦とりわけ→とりわけ：10399_toriwake⟧ ({取|と}り{分|わ}け, "especially") is written with the same kanji but is a different word.
